texto: Working all aspects of my game- technical, tactical, movement and strength!.

Muy recomendable el plan de entrenamiento. Se trabajan aspectos específicos del juego, técnicos y tácticos. Los profes son muy detallistas para que perfecciones el juego en lo que necesites. Vale la pena anotarte si quieres mejorar el nivel.

This academy is amazing. The coaches are awesome and the classes work as my game has gotten a lot better. They thought me how to volley better, control transition shots, and disguise a chiquita from a lob.
Great instructors, i definitely improved my overall game in a few weeks.

Ernesto, Guille and their team are excellent teachers. They not only helped perfect each stroke but took the time to work on strategy during each game situation. They really took my game from advanced to expert.

I’ve improved so much since joining this padel club. Joined as total beginner and now getting better and better. The coaches are knowledgeable, a good vibe, and great at helping you develop your game. The atmosphere and the crew feels like home to me.

Best padel academy in Florida. Coaches Guille and Ernesto have developed a system that works for different levels of players. If you are serious about taking your padel to the next level, reach out to them.

Una academia excelente. Los entrenadores te ponen mucha atención y se preocupan porque desarrolles tu juego. Particularmente Ernesto y Cris me han ayudado a entender el juego y mejorar. Lo recomiendo ampliamente

I’ve been training for about 2 months with Ernesto and I’ve been able to improve soo much within this short period of time, Ernesto is very patient and soo knowledgeable. He teached me all the technique and strategies of the game. Thank you !!

I joined the PadelEdge academy a few weeks ago and I'd highly recommend it to any player looking to improve their game. One of the things that stands out the most is their structured methodology. When you take clinics at many clubs, every coach tends to teach things slightly differently. At PadelEdge, coaches follow a very consistent system for how each shot should be executed, which makes learning much easier, even if it means retraining your mind and body after months/years of doing things a different way. No wrist movement, using the same preparation for multiple shots, etc. Sessions are very dynamic. Whether there are 2 players or 8 players training, the coaches adapt the drills so everyone stays involved. They are also very attentive and detail-oriented, even if that sometimes means they have to repeat the same correction several times because you're still doing it wrong (speaking from personal experience). Although in general there's still room to improve, and I have no doubt they will continue refining it, the academy is also very organized. Every weekend they send the full training schedule for the upcoming week, along with a summary of what we worked on the previous week, always using the same template. As someone who appreciates structure and organization, that’s definitely a plus for me. Overall, it's a great place to train, and I highly recommend it.

Instructors are great. I’ve done 3 lessons so far and my game is drastically changing. Im getting more confident at the net and understanding positioning much better than before. Im a low intermediate now and at this rate will be playing in advanced intermediate tournaments very soon.

Best Padel Club ever!!! Coaches are very dedicated and professionals. Improved a lot my game, they really put an effort on preparing the clases base on your needs. I am so much better player now. 💪🏼💪🏼💪🏼💪🏼
Amazing coaches that care about you, good teaching style that can be adapted to all levels, and good benefits to keep improving
